label: Missing data from one sweep on lack of amenities (CLS Harmonisation)
meta_rows: Missing data from one sweep on lack of amenities (CLS Harmonisation)

CLOSER work package 9: Harmonised childhood environment and adult wellbeing measures. If there was missing data for lackameni, then the measure was derived just using the data which was present at the other ages. A flag was created to show which cases these affected
cat_rows: This category contains data on the housing, household composition, number of children/grandchildren, whether living with partner, number of vehicles and pets. Includes the CLS harmonisation variables on number of children at different ages. Questions were asked in througout childhood and adulthood.
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
